data.name: The Starlight Amulet
data.detailed_description:
In order to survive an intense storm out on the open sea, you (crash) land your air balloon on a mysterious island! Will you be able to repair your balloon and escape, or will you start a new life with the island inhabitants?

Features

  • The perfect combination of exploratory metroidvania (Hollow Knight, Metroid) and social sim (Stardew Valley, Animal Crossing), to be enjoyed alone or co-opped with a friend/partner

  • Run, jump, climb, swing, battle, swim, paint, cook, perform music, decorate, socialize and much more; basically play the game the way you want!

  • Befriend the characters you meet in order to learn new abilities that let you reach new areas

  • More than 20 tools, weapons and items to equip

  • Defeat enemies, overcome platform challenges and solve puzzles in order to collect materials and furniture to improve the homes of your community

  • Continue to level up your friendships to learn incredible skills and upgrades that let you play in new creative ways

  • 20 island regions and 1000+ collectables

  • A plot with twists and surprises as well as a whole bunch of side-quests

  • Story, visuals, game design and music by FreddeGredde

    More information coming soon.
